costMethod.label: How the acquisition cost is set
costMethod.title: How to set the acquisition cost
costMethod.fifo: Oldest buys (FIFO). When you sell part of a position, the oldest shares are taken to go first. The acquisition cost is what you paid for exactly those.
costMethod.average: Weighted average. Each sold share costs the average price of all shares you held before the sale. The rest of Moony computes the realized gain this way, only without fees, so it can differ from this report.
costMethod.choose: Tax rules differ in which method they accept. Choose the one you file your tax return with. The holding period for the holding test counts from the oldest buys either way.

holdingTest.label: What the holding test is
holdingTest.title: Holding test
holdingTest.what: Some countries do not tax the gain from a sale of shares when you held them longer than a set period. The length differs by country, and some have no such rule.
holdingTest.when: Turn it on only when it applies to you, and set the length by your own rules: pick a preset, or choose Custom… and enter it in months. The report then splits the sold shares into exempt ones and those subject to tax.
holdingTest.tax: Moony does not compute the tax itself. A loss from an exempt sale does not lower the taxable result.

fx.label: How the currency is converted
fx.title: Conversion to {{currency}}
fx.rate: A buy and a sale are each converted at the ECB rate of their own day, so the result includes the movement of the exchange rate.
fx.return: A tax return may require a different rate, for example your central bank's daily or yearly rate. The difference is usually small.

dividends.label: Explanation: dividends (gross)
dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.body: Gross dividends before withholding tax, converted to {{currency}}. They are taxed differently from sales, so they are not in the result of sales.
